comment: Plain scalars that YAML 1.1 reads as numbers (issue #103, wave 018 run 0134), as the command line reads them: `expect` is what `query graph` prints (the references of the elements and the qualifiers that they have) or the one-line error without the file and the place (`file` is the file it names). Each case is a folder: `files` are its files (`workspace.yaml` is `settings: {manifests: {paths: [manifests]}}` when a case does not give it). YamlOneDotOneNumbersTest.java (command line) and yaml-numbers.test.js (editor) run every case; a case that has `editor` is one where the editor says another thing, with the `reason`. The expectations were written from the jar of archicode-0.16.0, which reads these scalars as the jar of this tree does. Y125 to Y279 (wave 019, run 0137, issues #136 and #78): where the reader meets a scalar it refuses (Y125 to Y144: the header is read key by key and the content whole, so `foo: .inf` under an unknown key of the header is the unknown key), the scalars with a tag (`!!int`, `!!float`, `!!binary`, `!!str`: Y145 to Y254, found by trying every spelling of up to five characters on Jackson 2.21 and the long ones that decide between `int`, `long` and `BigInteger`; a tagged integer or binary text it cannot read is refused when the reader gets to the token, a tagged float when a value is asked of it, Y255 to Y279), and the number a patch holds (Y252 to Y254). Their expectations were written from the jar of archicode-0.17.0 (build the jar and run it, do not guess).
